interface: local finite tape-program language and verified compiler over unchanged canonical NKtLB machine; source syntax is not claimed mission canonical
status: complete: core compiler and physical buffer-space bound publicly compiled and transitively audited

source_language.parameters: R fixed unary registers, B fixed explicit symbol buffers, L finite labels
instructions: decrement unary register or branch at zero
read/advance one canonical RO tape, branch on one symbol
buffer action: choose one buffer; inspect exactly its scanned Sym; use a four-entry Sym -> Sym x Move x Fin L table to write one symbol, move at most one cell, and choose one finite next label
source_language.buffer_representation: Fin B -> List Sym with Fin B -> Nat head positions; no entire array is encoded as a unary natural
source_language.initial_state: all registers and heads zero, all buffers/output empty, entry control label
source_language.cost: halt=0, inc=2, every other instruction including buffer=1

target_machine.oracle: query state unreachable for every oracle and input
target_machine.time: 1+2*t target steps for a halting source execution of t steps

proof_route: Reuse the completed CounterCompiler constructive finite-control encoding, CounterTape.getD_writeAt and unary microsteps, and CounterTape exact output-normalization theorem.
Place counters in canonical tapes 0..R-1, buffers in tapes R..R+B-1, output in R+B, and query in R+B+1. Prove disjointness and injectivity of the index maps.
Represent each buffer by extensional getD equality to its source list and exact head equality. Every idle canonical write preserves this invariant despite finite-list trailing-blank differences.
Extend every counter instruction simulation with buffer preservation. Prove a buffer instruction from scan-symbol equality, the canonical pointwise writeAt update, and the exact canonical Move rule.
Prove initialization, localSimulation for all seven instruction forms, exact accumulated-time run simulation, exact halting output, time padding, and no-query reachability.

nodes.statement: For code c.pc=buffer b action and Represents P c m, exactly one canonical target step represents the exact source cell update/Move/finite branch.
nodes.status: proved; included transitively in localSimulation audit

nodes.statement: For every actual finite TapeProgram P, every input/oracle, and every represented source/target configuration pair, P.cost c target steps represent P.step inp c.
forall (P : TapeProgram R B L) O inp t, P.halted (P.run inp t) -> (compile P).HaltsWith O inp (1+2*t) (bitsSym (P.run inp t).output)
forall P u t, P.halted (P.run <u,[],[],[]> t) -> (compile P).Computes (1+2*t) u (P.run <u,[],[],[]> t).output
forall P O inp t, ((compile P).run O inp t).state != (compile P).query
forall P inp t b, (P.run inp t).bufferHead b <= t and ((P.run inp t).bufferTape b).length <= t

bounded_tape_macro_api_outline.code: Port CounterProgram.Exec/Stops to TapeCfg, with every buffer field carried in the store. Relabel buffer action table targets by composing only its finite label component.
bounded_tape_macro_api_outline.intended_bound: Exact source steps; Stops from source init transfers through TapeCompiler.compile_halts.

bounded_tape_macro_api_outline.code: Reuse the explicit disjoint-code-table sequencing and header/body/exit loop construction from CounterLoops. Buffer instructions preserve all counters, so the Fresh counter check accepts them directly.
bounded_tape_macro_api_outline.intended_bound: Sequencing tP+1+tQ. A fresh-counter loop with body bound C has source bound n*(C+2)+1.

bounded_tape_macro_api_outline.code: Build finite buffer tables for move preserving the scanned symbol, write-constant/stay or write-constant/right, and branch-on-bit. Each is an actual TapeInstr.buffer, not a new abstract instruction.
bounded_tape_macro_api_outline.intended_bound: Exactly one source step per cell operation.

bounded_tape_macro_api_outline.code: Reserve bot at cell zero; use a fresh unary count to repeat right moves. Reset by a finite buffer table that preserves cells and moves left until bot. State array invariants using extensional getD equality, not literal trailing-blank list equality.
bounded_tape_macro_api_outline.intended_bound: Counted right seek with a one-step body <=3*n+1 source steps. Reset from head h with bot at zero <=h+1 source steps.

bounded_tape_macro_api_outline.code: Store m fixed-width w-bit entries explicitly on one buffer after the bottom marker. Compute the bounded unary offset i*w using counter routines, traverse actual cells, and read/write w cells. Use separate bounded unary registers for one field value or polynomial candidate; never pack all m entries into one register.
bounded_tape_macro_api_outline.intended_bound: Traversal is charged per cell, O(i*w+w); unary value arithmetic may use a loose polynomial in q, with q polynomial in the mission input length.

bounded_tape_macro_api_outline.code: Store variable-size matrices/form/hash tables in the explicit flat buffers, using fixed finitely many heads/buffers and loop/index registers. Instantiate invariants and actual finite body-program traces for each row/column operation.
bounded_tape_macro_api_outline.intended_bound: Combine bounded loop iteration counts, charged array traversals, and proved finite-field arithmetic routine costs into a source polynomial; the existing compiler supplies constant target overhead.

limitations: No array-access macro is treated as a primitive. The outlined seek/read/write/arithmetic programs and their proofs remain future work.
Sampler/tester code, exact fair-bit distribution, finite-field algorithm correctness, and their source polynomial bounds are not established by this generic compiler.
R, B, and L are parameters of a fixed finite source program; mission uses must choose one such program independently of the varying input length.
